name: High-Density EEG System (128-Channel)
description: State-of-the-art electroencephalography cap utilizing active wet gel electrodes to record electrical brain activity with millisecond temporal resolution.
utility: Measures cortical event-related potentials (ERPs), frequency bands (alpha, beta, theta, delta), and neural oscillations during cognitive tasks.

name: Biopac ECG & Respiration Module
description: Multi-lead electrocardiogram coupled with a piezoelectric chest band to capture cardiac electrical activity and respiration rate simultaneously.
utility: Extracts heart rate variability (HRV), sympathetic-parasympathetic balance indices, and respiration-locked cardiac arrythmia (RSA).

name: Galvanic Skin Response (GSR/EDA) Sensor
description: Fingertip skin conductance sensor measuring electrodermal activity (EDA), specifically sweat gland activation triggered by the sympathetic nervous system.
utility: Acts as a primary indicator of emotional arousal, stress, cognitive effort, and orienting reflexes.

name: Tobii Pro Spectrum Eye Tracker
description: High-speed, dual-camera screen-based eye tracker tracking gaze points, fixations, saccades, and pupil diameters with extreme accuracy.
utility: Measures visual attention, cognitive load (via pupil dilation), reading patterns, and emotional reactions to visual stimuli.

name: Prefrontal fNIRS Explorer
description: Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy headband mapping hemodynamic responses (oxygenated and deoxygenated hemoglobin) in the prefrontal cortex.
utility: Provides spatial localization of prefrontal executive control, decision making, and cognitive workload.

name: EyeLoop Closed-Loop Eye Tracker
description: An open-source, high-speed Python 3 eye-tracking system designed for dynamic, closed-loop neuroscience and behavioral experiments.
utility: Supports real-time gaze estimation, pupil contour tracking, and custom experimental loops with high-speed video capture and OBS virtual camera integration.

specs.features: Kalman & KDE smoothing filters, online calibration, virtual camera
